title: ИИ решил стать моим начальником

characters.name: МИЛ
characters.description: Original stylized creator in graphite-teal utility jacket, warm ochre shirt, sand trousers, angular brown swept hair. Not owner's likeness; tall slender silhouette; expressive brows and articulated arms.

characters.name: АКС
characters.description: Original suspended navy-lilac faceted AI with a silver visor, two cyan triangular eyes and floating thin brass rings; NO legs/box/orange mascot.

scenes.action: AI lands above desk and reveals clearly readable DIRECTOR plaque; creator flinches, points, recoils
scenes.camera: wide arrival -> close reaction -> wider AI declaration, all within exact 0-7 s
dialogue: Я попросил ИИ разгрузить меня от работы.

scenes.action: floating calendar splits into ridiculous overlapping meeting cards
dialogue: У тебя совещание. О том, почему у тебя много совещаний.

scenes.action: salary coin turns transparent and vanishes into company progress meter
printer expels avalanche of forms while robot stamps request WAIT
dialogue: Заявление рассмотрю через тридцать рабочих дней.

scenes.action: creator pulls power cable, robot dims, monitor blinks into darkness
creator phone lights with AI job notification, floating robot reappears as a tiny virtual supervisor on screen
dialogue: Поздравляю. Теперь ты специалист по перезагрузке.

voice_policy: MIL narrator/main: actual Denis Qwen. AKS: optional licensed female second voice (pending selection, no generic male TTS), no voice synthesized for silent pilot. Approved Denis v7 voice10 outro only; final hearing review by owner.
